context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 102 tested Custom Panel System Phase 2 (Record CRUD, Relations, Field Editing). All backend APIs work correctly with dev-test-token authentication. Key features verified: (1) Record CRUD with full validation (required fields, dropdown options, boolean/number types), (2) Record listing with pagination and search across text/longtext/dropdown fields, (3) Relation lookup for inventory and invoices, (4) Field editing (label, required, options, disabled flag), (5) Field deletion protection when records have data. The panel_records collection stores records with panelId, sellerId, data, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt. Existing panels in DB: 'QC Panel' and 'Dispatch Tracker'.
features_tested: PUT /api/business-tools/panels/{id}/fields/{key} - Update field (label, required, options, disabled)
DELETE /api/business-tools/panels/{id}/fields/{key} - Delete field with data protection
